rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice when talking about a kind or type of thing in ordinary speech.

example.english: These products belong to the same category.
example.traditional: 呢啲貨品屬於同一種類。
example.jyutping: ni1 di1 fo3 ban2 suk6 jyu1 tung4 jat1 zung2 leoi6

rows.note: Use this for a recognizable type or category defined by shared features, especially when discussing products, people, or situations.

example.english: What category does this movie fall into?
example.jyutping: ni1 tou3 hei3 hai6 me1 leoi6 jing4 gaa3

rows.note: Use this when the category is part of an explicit classification, list, form, or set of named groups.

example.english: Please select the correct category on the form.
example.traditional: 請喺表格揀返正確嘅類別。
example.jyutping: cing2 hai2 biu2 gaak3 gaan2 faan1 zing3 kok3 ge3 leoi6 bit6
